scope: immutable round1 snapshot only; planned strands excluded
conclusion: Bounded historical distinctions survive. General complements explanation is not established; close P2 inferential repairs before treating cross-case tests as discriminating causal support.
forecast_assessment: No forecast leap requiring withdrawal in conditional future-role document; C06 is a scope/wording repair.

findings.title: Printing niches do not discriminate against the serious script-cost rival
findings.problem: A rejection about relative uptake is supported by counterexamples only to all-tasks script determinism. A published script-sensitive cost model predicts those same niches.
findings.correction: Retain rejection of impossibility; change relative-uptake explanation to unresolved and include explicit cost-model rival.
acceptance_criteria: Register and NET-K08 state the same bounded hypothesis.
Include Angeles or equivalent explicit rival; mark comparison underdetermined unless independent evidence separates predictions.
Do not count model fit to inherited niche observations as independent corroboration.
findings.residual_uncertainty: Historical cost calibration and publication quantities remain uncertain.

findings.title: Distinguish evaluated mechanisms from stage distinctions and unavailable evidence
findings.problem: Downstream use being unestablished is treated alongside directly observed constrained use as a mechanism test. Source silence cannot disprove deployment without a preservation/detection argument.
findings.correction: Separate measurement/source-entailment claims, universal-implication counterexamples and positive causal mechanism claims. Preserve identified package effects on their own terms.
acceptance_criteria: No source silence is encoded as observed non-adoption.
Each synthesis record specifies the proposition tested and actual discriminating observations.
Causal status corresponds to the asserted proposition rather than the strongest constituent source.
findings.residual_uncertainty: Absence of ancient deployment remains unknown; stove mediators remain unidentified.

findings.title: Operationalize complementarity separately from joint benefit, necessity and adoption
findings.problem: Benefit unavailable from either input alone can arise from simple addition, so the table does not uniquely define complementarity. An output interaction also does not by itself identify adoption causes.
findings.correction: State a marginal interaction on a declared outcome scale; record necessity and substitutable routes separately; distinguish outcome production from chooser investment.
acceptance_criteria: Provide one worked interaction contrast and one package/non-example.
Declare outcome, actor, interval and scale.
Date alleged causal inputs before outcomes; mark engineering evidence as such when no causal contrast is estimable.
findings.residual_uncertainty: Interaction estimates depend on scale and design assumptions; cross-domain generality remains untested.

findings.title: Clarify maintenance adequacy before using the case to test an explanation
findings.problem: Current underdetermination caveats are substantively appropriate. A future discriminating use needs pre-outcome adequacy criteria so poor outcomes do not define a missing complement after the fact.
findings.correction: Retain caveats and label proposed arrows; require independently measured provision/demand/service contrasts only before upgrading the causal claim. Keep resistance onset separate from detection.
acceptance_criteria: Retain the existing underdetermination flags; clarify hypothesized arrows.
Before upgrading the maintenance inference, provide a dated contrast with adequacy defined independently of outcomes, or keep the conclusion at compatibility.
Keep onset versus detection distinct in MED-K16.
findings.residual_uncertainty: Repair, design, task fit and demand remain bundled; malaria causal shares remain unresolved.

findings.title: Remove a possible risk-versus-cash ranking from the hypothesis summary
findings.problem: Dominates can imply comparable treatment intensity or a policy ranking; future liquidity constraints can contribute to the insurance response.
findings.correction: Describe insurance-only investment response and smaller cash-only response under tested contracts, without ranking constraints across settings.
acceptance_criteria: Remove dominates and retain contract/state-contingency scope.
Treat Mali as an omitted challenge case, not a matched replication or refutation of Ghana.
findings.residual_uncertainty: Mechanism transportability and comparable intervention value remain unestablished.

findings.title: Replace employment recovery with the measured cohort comparison
findings.problem: Recovery suggests a within-person or within-cohort transition that stable subsequent-cohort employment does not demonstrate.
findings.correction: Say adverse linked-incumbent outcomes coexisted with no measured reduction in overall employment for subsequent young female cohorts in the study population.
acceptance_criteria: Replace recovery; keep scope and observational qualifications near the example.
Do not infer incumbent rehabilitation from later cohort outcomes.
findings.residual_uncertainty: Linked-sample selection, individual earnings and full transition welfare remain incomplete.
